Drikall and Scut, you each had three hits on the ball and none against your fellows, but Drikall, you shot thirteen times and Scut ten, so Scut wins the tiebreaker&hellip;Jesmin, one shot, one hit on the ball, none on any of us. '''Backstop''' was a target-shooting game invented by [[Trey Courser]], a member of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]]. In the game, one player served as the Controller, using a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] to maneuver a [[floating droid]] around a circle of players armed with toy laser pistols that fired harmless beams of light. The goal is to hit the moving target while avoiding friendly fire. The droid automatically recorded hits and misses, with players ranked by the number of successful hits and accuracy at the end of each timed round.<ref name="MK" />
